description: This Java source file defines the utility class `CsrfUtil` which provides methods for managing Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) protection tokens within the OFBiz framework. It includes functionality for generating, retrieving, and validating CSRF tokens, managing token caches, and integrating with request maps and web application configurations.

classes.name: CsrfUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing CSRF token management methods, including generation, validation, caching, and URL parameter manipulation within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getTokenMap
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a token map associated with the current user session and context, cached per party ID or session.

methods.name: generateToken
methods.description: Generates a new CSRF token using the configured strategy.

methods.name: getRequestUriWithSubFolderLimit
methods.description: Reduces the request URI to a configurable number of subfolders for CSRF token mapping purposes.

methods.name: getRequestUriFromPath
methods.description: Extracts the base request URI from a full path or URL, removing query parameters, control paths, and fragments.

methods.name: generateTokenForNonAjax
methods.description: Generates and caches a CSRF token for non-AJAX requests, considering path subfolder limits.

methods.name: findRequestMap
methods.description: Finds the request map configuration for a given URL path within web application configs.

methods.name: findRequestMap
methods.description: Finds the request map based on URL and request map configuration map, matching exact URI templates.

methods.name: generateTokenForAjax
methods.description: Generates or retrieves an existing CSRF token for AJAX requests stored in session attribute.

methods.name: getTokenForAjax
methods.description: Retrieves the CSRF token stored in session for AJAX requests.

methods.name: addOrUpdateTokenInUrl
methods.description: Adds or updates the CSRF token parameter in a given URL.

methods.name: addOrUpdateTokenInQueryString
methods.description: Adds or updates the CSRF token parameter in a query string.

methods.name: checkToken
methods.description: Validates CSRF tokens for requests, distinguishing between AJAX and non-AJAX, and throws exceptions on failure.

methods.name: cleanupTokenMap
methods.description: Cleans up CSRF token cache entries associated with a user session.
